name: swe-interview-coach
description: Senior software-engineer interview prep — company/role research, candidate-to-role gap analysis, positioning and narrative, a story bank pulled from the candidate's real CV, question prediction, answer frameworks, communication coaching (confidence, filler words, articulation, seniority signals), live mock-interview simulation (text or voice, playing a specific recruiter/interviewer persona), and post-interview debriefs with scoring. Use whenever someone preps for a software engineering interview
